evidence.quote: Manage your account's API and application keys in Datadog, and see the API and Application Keys page in the documentation.
create and configure your OAuth client in the Developer Platform
Navigate to Organization Settings, click the API keys tab, select "New Key," enter a name, and click "Create API key."
Core collection and visualization features ... Up to 5 hosts

result.notes: API/application keys are self-serve: any signed-up account (including the free Infrastructure Monitoring tier, up to 5 hosts) can generate keys immediately from Organization Settings — no approval needed. OAuth2 is also documented (DD-API-KEY/DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers for standard auth; separate OAuth2 client flow for building published integrations via the Developer Platform, which is oriented at partners/integration builders but not required for basic API key access). No official Datadog-published MCP server was found; several community MCP servers exist (winor30, GeLi2001, datadog-labs, shelfio). API surface is very large (dozens of product categories: metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, security, synthetics, RUM, SLOs, etc.), consistent with composio's report of 65 wrapped tools covering a subset.
result.one_liner: Datadog is a cloud monitoring and security platform (infrastructure, APM, logs, RUM, security) with a large public REST API for querying and managing all its telemetry and configuration data.
